MASTER-OAGH robotic telescope  [1]  located in Mexico (OAGH National Institute for Astrophysics, Optics and Electronics) started inspect of the Fermi GRB260424.65 (trigger No 798737427,11h 26m 57.60s , +20d 14m 24.0s, R=14.8) errorbox  41869 sec after notice time and 41891 sec after trigger time at 2026-04-25 03:08:33 UT, with upper limit up to  18.9 mag. Observations started at twilight.  The observations began at zenith distance = 32 deg. The sun  altitude  is -16.0 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = 70 deg., longitude l = 229 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3269496
